description: Switches an AI+ shot to one of its saved versions (a number from list_ai_versions). Uses no credit; undoable. A version made for a shorter spot can't fill a longer shot; a shot without AI+ gets it with request_ai_plus, which reuses a matching saved version without a new credit.

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

version.description: The saved AI+ version to use: its number from list_ai_versions.

name: use_ai_version
title: Use an AI+ version
